pattern: SELECT .+ AS TotalCost FROM \w+\s+JOIN\s+\w+\s+ON\s+\w+\.\w+= \w+\.\w+ GROUP BY .+ ORDER BY TotalCost .+ LIMIT 1
correction: GROUP BY the grouped column and order by the aggregated column instead of aliasing it as TotalCost

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries where the SUM or other aggregate function is used to calculate a total, but the query does not group by the corresponding column and instead aliases it as TotalCost.
